name: he111
_comment: FlightGear model coords (x aft, y right, z up, metres) of Heinkel-He-111/Models/he111.xml. The .ac has the main gear modelled down and the gear doors closed (he111.xml door animations are 0 deg at position-norm 0), so the main struts and wheels are dropped; the tail wheel is turned up by its retraction rotation. Guns (Models/Interior/Guns/guns.xml, three instances in interior.xml): guns = nose (A-Stand), guns#1 = ventral gondola (C-Stand, aft), guns#2 = dorsal (B-Stand, aft) -> gun_rear. Instrument panel, shadow, lights and the interior-only glass are dropped.

rotations._comment: tail wheel retracted (gear[2] position-norm 0 -> -45 deg about FG +y)

nodes._comment: dorsal MG 15 (B-Stand) behind the cockpit glazing; rest pose points aft and 20 deg up (interior.xml offsets). Pivot = the gun's mount (guns.xml origin)
nodes.name: gun_rear
